app.name: Ortak Randevu
app.tagline: Easy scheduling for anyone who takes bookings.

home.headline: Scheduling without the back-and-forth.
home.kicker: Easy scheduling for anyone who takes bookings
home.lede: Share one link. Clients pick a time. Confirmations go out — no extra accounts, no clinical records.
home.ctaHint: No password. We’ll email a sign-in link.

how.title: How it works
how.lede: Three steps. Then send the link.
how.step1Body: Add a service and the times you take bookings.
how.step2Body: Your public page is yours to send — chat, email, or your site.
how.step3Body: They book with name, email, and phone. You both get confirmation.

features.label: Product
features.bookingBody: Name, email, and phone — that’s the whole form. No health details, ever.
features.hoursBody: Weekly windows and closed days, in Europe/Istanbul unless you change it.
features.confirmBody: Double-booking is blocked in the database. Confirmations go to both inboxes.

mock.confirmNote: Email sent to both of you.

close.title: Ready when you are.
close.lede: Create your page, share the link, get booked.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: We will email a one-time link. No password.
auth.sendFailed: Could not send the sign-in link. Try again.
auth.sentBody: Open the sign-in link we just sent. It works once and expires in a few minutes.
auth.accountDeleted: Your account was deleted. Contact details were removed; booking times stay on file without your name or email.
auth.googleFailed: Could not sign in with Google. Try again, or use the email link.
auth.signInDenied: Sign-in was cancelled or this account cannot sign in.

me.title: Your account
me.bookingPathNote: Share this link. Clients book without an account.

availability.title: Availability
availability.intro: Hours are in {tz}. Clients can book in {grid}-minute steps, up to {days} days ahead.
availability.servicesEmpty: Add a service (for example a 30-minute consultation) before clients can book.
availability.hoursHint: Leave both times blank to close that day. Saving refreshes open times.
availability.slotsEmpty: No open times yet. Add a service and weekly hours.

saved.hours: Weekly hours saved. Open times were refreshed.
saved.service: Service added. Open times were refreshed.
saved.exception: Closed day saved. Open times were refreshed.

errors.DURATION_NOT_GRID: Duration must be a multiple of 15 minutes.

errors.WEEKDAY_DUPLICATE: Each weekday can only have one hours window.
errors.HOURS_CONFLICT: Those hours could not be saved because of an existing row. Try again.

dashboard.policy: You can change this booking anytime. Marking completed or no-show keeps the time blocked.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Your display name appears on your booking page. Language is used in the app and in emails we send you.
settings.displayNameHint: Optional. Leave blank to show only your booking page name.
settings.localeHint: English is the default. Turkish is available here.
settings.privacyIntro: You can download a copy of your account and booking records, or delete your account. Deletion removes your name, email, and bio. Appointment times stay so guests can still open their booking link. This is not legal advice.
settings.exportHint: JSON file with your profile and bookings (who, when, service, status). No health records — we do not store those.
settings.deleteHint: This cannot be undone. You will be signed out. The same email can be used later only as a new account.
settings.deleteConfirm: I understand my name, email, and bio will be removed.

calendar.title: Calendars
calendar.intro: Connect Google Calendar so busy times on that calendar are not offered on your booking page. This is separate from signing in with Google.
calendar.googleHint: We only read free/busy intervals — not event titles. Writing Ortak bookings back to Google comes in a later update.
calendar.syncFailedHint: Last sync failed. Try Sync now, or disconnect and connect again.
calendar.notConfigured: Google Calendar connect is not configured on this deployment yet.

flash.google_connected: Google Calendar connected. Busy times are now hidden from your booking page.
flash.google_disconnected: Google Calendar disconnected. Busy blocks were cleared.
flash.google_synced: Busy times refreshed from Google Calendar.
flash.google_invalid: That Google Calendar link was invalid or expired. Try again.
flash.google_error: Could not connect or sync Google Calendar. Try again.
flash.google_not_configured: Google Calendar OAuth is not configured on this server.
flash.auth_required: Sign in again to connect a calendar.
